sn22.100:1.3: pubbā koṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ.
sn22.100:1.4: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, sā gaddulabaddho daḷhe khīle vā thambhe vā upanibaddho. so gacchati cepi tameva khīlaṃ vā thambhaṃ vā upagacchati. tiṭṭhati cepi tameva khīlaṃ vā thambhaṃ vā upatiṭṭhati, nisīdati ce’pi tameva khīlaṃ vā thambhaṃ vā upanisīdati, nipajjati. cepi tameva khīlaṃ vā thambhaṃ vā upanipajjati.
sn22.100:1.5: “evameva kho bhikkhave, assutavā puthujjano rūpaṃ “etaṃ mama, eso’hamasmi, eso me attā”ti samanupassati.
sn22.100:1.9: viññāṇaṃ ‘etaṃ mama eso’hamasmi, eso me attā”ti samanupassati.
sn22.100:1.10: so gacchati ce’pi imeva pañcupādānakkhandhe upagacchati.
sn22.100:1.14: tasmātiha bhikkhave, bhikkhunā abhikkhaṇaṃ sakaṃ cittaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ
sn22.100:1.15: dīgharattamidaṃ cittaṃ saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ. rāgena dosena mohenāti.
sn22.100:2.1: diṭṭhaṃ vo bhikkhave, caraṇaṃ nāma cittanti?
sn22.100:2.3: tampi kho bhikkhave, caraṇaṃ cittaṃ citteneva cittitaṃ. tena’pi kho bhikkhave, caraṇena cittena cittaññeva cittataraṃ.
sn22.100:2.4: tasmātiha bhikkhave, bhikkhunā abhikkhaṇaṃ sakaṃ cittaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ
sn22.100:3.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekanikāyampi samanupassāmi, evaṃ cittaṃ. yathayidaṃ bhikkhave, tiracchānagatā pāṇā.
sn22.100:3.2: te’pi kho bhikkhave, tiracchānagatā pāṇā citteneva cittitā, tehi’pi kho bhikkhave, tiracchānagatehi pāṇehi cittaññeva cittataraṃ.
sn22.100:3.3: tasmātiha bhikkhave, bhikkhunā abhikkhaṇaṃ sakaṃ cittaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ
sn22.100:4.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, rajako vā cittakārako vā sati rajanāya vā lākhāya vā haliddiyā vā nīlāya vā mañjeṭṭhāya vā suparimaṭṭe vā phalake bhittiyā vā dussapaṭe vā itthirūpaṃ vā purisarūpaṃ vā abhinimmineyya sabbaṅgapaccaṅgaṃ.
sn22.100:4.2: evameva kho bhikkhave, assutavā puthujjano rūpaññeva abhinibbattento abhinibbatteti. vedanaññeva …pe… saññaññeva …pe… saṅkhāreyeva …pe… viññāṇaṃyeva abhinibbattento abhinibbatteti.
sn22.100:4.9: viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti? aniccaṃ bhante …pe…
